# dokku_buildpacks (Data Source)

Manages the buildpacks for a given dokku application

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dokku_buildpacks" "example" {
  app = "node-js-app"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String) Name of the app

### Read-Only

- `buildpacks` (List of String) List of buildpack URLs (order is significant)
- `id` (String) The resource's identity address.
